headline: Bitcoin Rises 2.16 Percent To 81k As $18.96 Billion Moves Onto Exchanges
narrative: Bitcoin rose 2.16 percent to 81k, the crypto pipe taking the session bid. Exchanges took in $18.96 billion over 24 hours, 7.04 percent of reserves, a distribution pipe with coins arriving on venues rather than leaving them. Bitcoin held on exchanges rose by 15,138 coins over seven days to 1,264,170, so supply has been moving toward the market underneath the higher spot price.
author: jordan
